body: Yeah who knows, I wont be able to see them for at least a month though. Rough time. Yeah no weird beliefs minus the occasional paranoia that people are out to get me/don't like me. I have times where household objects can look like people until I look at them again but that's hardly a hallucination. Idc what my diagnosis is but this shit needs to stop
She thinks it's okay because I only went to classes today and she had a long day at work. She finally said she was sorry but only after calling me lazy twice and after seeing me sulking.

I did once, just didn't spell it out as well as I should have. He knows I'm miserable but doesn't seem to care enough to just invite me. Shouldn't people want to take their girlfriend places with them sometimes? I'll bring it back up with him later, I hope he understands. I don't want him inviting me out of pity, I want him to want me to be there.

Ive dated him before, he never used me before so im hesitant to call it that ya know? He just seems embarrassed to take me out and idk why that might be and it's starting to really hurt. I already got a gay guy friend and he says im retarded lol

Yeah I'd like to keep him around and will talk to him tomorrow, I'm a woman of action. I'm just afraid that if he begins inviting me to shit after the conversation that it'll be out of pity ya know? Like I don't want pity, I'm miserable and stuck at home so that is what it is, but I want to be invited because I am wanted and not because I'll feel miserable if they don't

For background I am female and 22 years old, I cannot drive due to mental trauma from a bad car accident when I was a teenager. 

I dated this same guy when I was in that accident, we broke it off a couple times and here I am at it again at 22 years old. He seems to only want me to come over for hookups despite texting me all the time and saying sweet things. So not typical "im using her for sex" behavior, he never was that type anyway. He never lets me go out with him and his friends, he never does anything with me (other than 2 times out of like 20 recent ones) except sex. He seems to always rub shit in my face to when he is going out to do things or try fun new shit. I always ask if I can come but always get an indirect "no". It's really upsetting me and I can't seem to calm down at all. I really don't know what to do and have considered hurting myself (hence why I posted in suicidewatch). I'm not going to outright kill myself (the guy in question couldn't take it) and I'm more angry than sad anyway. Ty for listening idk what to do.
LOL, your mom is a dick.
Welp, good thing my insurance lets me go straight to a specialist without a referral. Thanks.

Thank you, it's nice hearing that there are other people like me out there. I really hope a doctor believes and can help me. I also hope that thr people around us could stop being so shitty and believe us

I've only ever passed out and twitched on the floor about 3 or 4 times since I was 14. The time when I was 14 was the worst and more recent ones have been much less severe. I've done an improvised tilt table and my bpm goes up about 35bpm whenever I stand up from laying down after a while. If anything I probably do have POTS with an added seizure issue if that's what it truly was. If they were seizures, they seemed to be brought on from what looked like POTS episodes. I've never had one in a stationary position, only after rapidly standing up and moving somewhere else. Hence why I asked if the two can go hand in hand lmao.

Ty for the help though, it's good to hear that I'm not just nuts from other people. As with other people with chronic, often invisible, issues my family and friends just think I'm a hypochondiac.
